findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: web_read · Private data: contract_xray, solidity_red_flag_scan, wallet_xray, contract_xray_peek, solidity_scan_peek, wallet_xray_peek, governance_attack_cost · Public sink: contract_xray.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: web_read · Private data: contract_xray, solidity_red_flag_scan, wallet_xray, contract_xray_peek, solidity_scan_peek, wallet_xray_peek, governance_attack_cost · Public sink: contract_xray

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
